name: datalib-tauri
//: Pins the Tauri CLI that build-signed-app.sh runs through pnpm-lock.yaml. The signing job installs it before the Developer ID certificate reaches it and then runs it straight from node_modules, so it resolves nothing from the registry at signing time; a bare `pnpm dlx @tauri-apps/cli@2` picked whatever 2.x was current that day. Installed with --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts: the CLI's platform binary is an integrity-pinned optional dependency, not an install script.
